methodology.reference: FP64 formulas on exact FP32 inputs; explicit tanh-GELU; RMS/LayerNorm epsilon=1e-5; fixed label zero cross entropy; no affine norms; Adam-like has no bias correction/weight decay
methodology.precision: FP32 inputs/accumulation/outputs or uint32 bit patterns; no TF32
methodology.exact_pointwise_reference: single residual add/multiply rounded once to FP32; mask-scale follows two explicit FP32 operations
methodology.vector_contract: scalar4/vector4 require N multiple4; vector4 pointers16bytealigned; scalar odd-tail checks separately
methodology.compiler_control: same PTX, ptxas -O3; no vendor-library attribution
methodology.case_order: seeded permutation then reverse; no selection in worker
methodology.candidate_change: local product+sum contracted into explicit FMA; all warp synchronization and masks retained
methodology.candidate_numerical_contract: original unchanged per-op FP64 tolerances; no approximation-policy relaxation
